name: Sunil Agro Foods Limited
about: Sunil Agro Foods Limited wheat products and trades in wheat and wheat products in India. The company offers a range of products, including maida, sooji, atta, bran rough (fine and deluxe), bran flakes, wheat (including husk), rice, and gunny bags under the Sunil brand. It also provides conversion and packing services. It sells its products through distributors, modern trade, and direct sale channels. Sunil Agro Foods Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
